mapper.sql: FROM property_unit p JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=p.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id LEFT JOIN layout_template lt ON lt.layout_template_id=p.layout_template_id LEFT JOIN property_floor_plan pfp ON pfp.property_unit_id=p.property_unit_id LEFT JOIN file_object fo ON fo.file_object_id=pfp.file_object_id AND fo.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN layout_template_floor_plan_variant ltfpv ON ltfpv.layout_template_id=p.layout_template_id AND ltfpv.gross_area=p.gross_area AND ltfpv.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN file_object vfo ON vfo.file_object_id=ltfpv.file_object_id AND vfo.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN layout_template_floor_plan ltfp ON ltfp.layout_template_id=p.layout_template_id LEFT JOIN file_object tfo ON tfo.file_object_id=ltfp.file_object_id AND tfo.status='ACTIVE'

where.if: AND (p.property_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.community_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR b.building_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR COALESCE(b.building_name,'') LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR bu.unit_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR COALESCE(lt.layout_name,'') LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.sql: p.property_unit_id,p.building_unit_id,b.building_id,c.community_id, p.layout_template_id,c.community_name,b.building_no,b.building_name,bu.unit_no,bu.unit_name, p.property_no,p.floor_no,p.gross_area,p.usable_area,p.property_use,p.status,p.occupancy_status, p.version,lt.layout_code,lt.layout_name,lt.layout_type, COALESCE(fo.file_object_id,vfo.file_object_id,tfo.file_object_id) AS floor_plan_file_id, COALESCE(fo.content_type,vfo.content_type,tfo.content_type) AS floor_plan_content_type, CASE WHEN fo.file_object_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PROPERTY' WHEN vfo.file_object_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'VARIANT' WHEN tfo.file_object_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'TEMPLATE' ELSE NULL END AS floor_plan_source, p.created_at,p.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE p.property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId}AND 1 = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE property_unit SET layout_template_id=#{entity.layoutTemplateId},floor_no=#{entity.floorNo}, gross_area=#{entity.grossArea},usable_area=#{entity.usableArea}, property_use=COALESCE(#{entity.propertyUse},property_use),status=#{effectiveStatus}, occupancy_status=#{effectiveOccupancyStatus},version=version+1 WHERE property_unit_id=#{propertyUnitId} AND version=#{entity.version}
